title: Calm Sentences
intro: Slow, soft sentences. There is no clock to beat.
lines: The kettle hums while the afternoon light moves across the desk.
Take your time; the words will wait for you.
A quiet moment is a good place to start.
Rain taps the window and the room feels a little softer.
You can type as slowly as you like.
Somewhere a clock ticks, but it is not hurrying you.
Breathe in, breathe out, and find the next letter.
Every line is a fresh page.
